name: Northampton Newcomers B 2024
information: **Northampton Newcomers 2024 is a series competition. This competition (the B competition) will take place on Saturday afternoon.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersB2024#38753-competitor-information) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age. **This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersB2024#38847-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbnhmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7ba00c92956d73843dac03263db2d54fe08848f8/image.png)
